answer: Rotating co-presence slot leases. Each identity maps to one recurring in-person slot at a local haven, witnessed by rotating peers and a signed sensor log; duplicate slots are rejected. An attacker must recruit distinct people to occupy those slots for a full epoch, paying travel and time per identity. A sparrow-sized audit sample randomly rechecks a small fraction of slots with photo hashes. Any missed recheck revokes the slot and its dependent relic credentials.
